map.结构设计时，按荷载、跨度与截面刚度估算受弯构件挠度，校核是否满足 GB 5001: In structural design, estimate the deflection of flexural members from the load, span and section stiffness, and check whether it satisfies the deflection limits of GB 50010 / JTG 3362 (such as L/250, L/400).
map.既有结构开裂与下挠诊断：检测单位用实测跨度和荷载反算挠度，对比规范限值判断是否需: Cracking and downward deflection diagnosis of existing structures: testing organizations back-calculate deflection from measured span and load, and compare against code limits to decide whether strengthening is needed (steel plate bonding, carbon fiber or a larger section).
map.预制构件起拱设计：生产单位根据挠度估算值预设反拱，避免吊装后外观下垂，尤其对大跨: Camber design of precast members: producers preset the counter-camber from the estimated deflection to avoid the sagged appearance after lifting, especially for large-span prestressed beams and slabs.
map.均布荷载 q=20 kN/m、跨度 L=6 m、抗弯刚度 EI=2.0e8 kN: Uniformly distributed load q=20 kN/m, span L=6 m, flexural stiffness EI=2.0e8 kN·m²: midspan deflection 5qL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 10.1 mm, about L/594, below the common limit L/400 (15 mm), so stiffness is satisfied. Reducing EI lets you observe the deflection rise.
map.挠度限值一般取多少？: What deflection limit is normally used?
map.混凝土梁板按 GB 50010 通常取 L/200~L/400（依使用功能），桥: Concrete beams and slabs per GB 50010 usually take L/200~L/400 (depending on function), while bridges per JTG 3362 take L/400~L/600; members carrying dynamic loads such as crane beams are stricter. The design documents govern.
map.为什么要考虑长期挠度？: Why must long-term deflection be considered?
map.混凝土徐变与收缩会使挠度随时间增长，长期挠度可达短期值的 1.5~2 倍，预应力: Concrete creep and shrinkage make deflection grow over time, and long-term deflection can reach 1.5~2 times the short-term value; prestressed members also require deducting the counter-camber, so the design should superimpose these.
map.结果能直接出具检测报告吗？: Can the result be issued directly as an inspection report?
map.本工具为理论估算，正式检测须现场实测挠度、核对荷载史并附仪器检定证书，结果仅供初: This tool gives a theoretical estimate. Formal inspection requires field-measured deflection, verification of the load history and attached instrument calibration certificates, so the results are only for preliminary judgement and scheme comparison.
